verdict.line: You lose if you eat repeated Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke with no minion behind him for E (Facebreaker) and get caught by a charged W (Path Maker); you win if you bank Grit through that poke phase and force fights once his Q stacks and E (Footwork) are both down.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) is a 3.5s-cooldown poke tool and his W (Path Maker) is a charge-then-dash stun, and together they give him the steady lane pressure and safer solo-kill threat the data confirms, even though the head-to-head is a near coinflip at 50.3% over 1037 games. Sett has zero ranged answer to that poke, so the whole lane hinges on whether you survive it long enough to bank Grit for W (Haymaker) and land a real E (Facebreaker) stun instead of just a slow.

theirWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can charge to reduce incoming damage, then dash up to 600 range for a knockback and stun. Don't stand in that dash lane or trade auto-for-auto while he's charging.

yourWindow.when: his Q stacks and E (Footwork) are both down
yourWindow.what: He has no dash-shield and no shockwave pull available. Use Q (Knuckle Down) for the move speed bonus to close distance, land the two bonus max-health-damage attacks, and only commit E (Facebreaker) as a stun if a minion is sitting on his far side; otherwise it's just a slow.

start.why: The 51.3% win rate over 1010 games line — extra HP and sustain to soak the Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke chain without burning summoners early.

boots.why: 52.5% over 650 games and the higher pick rate; the flat damage reduction directly blunts his auto-attack and Q poke damage through lane.

core.why: Highest-winrate opener at 66.7% over 144 games; the armor shred keeps your Q (Knuckle Down) bonus damage and autos relevant even as he stacks resistances.
Gives you your own gap-close and slow to pair with Q's move-speed steroid, so you can actually close distance he'd otherwise dash away with E (Footwork).
The HP and regen scale directly with Pit Grit's missing-health regen, turning extended trades into ones you win as they drag on.

situational.when: he's landing his full All Out (R) combo on you and you need the shield to survive the burst
he builds up his resistances and you need the active slow to stop him resetting fights with E (Footwork)
you're already ahead and want the cooldown reduction to loop Q and E faster in prolonged skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.5% over the higher-winrate page; Conqueror rewards exactly the drawn-out trades Sett wants — stack it while banking Grit, then cash it in when W (Haymaker) comes out.

summoners.why: 83.4% pick rate at 50.3% win rate — the standard line. Ignite punishes his all-in commitments and adds a finishing threat once you've ground him down with Grit-fueled trades.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: Watch the Ntofo Strikes stacks on his portrait. At 2 stacks he fires a shockwave that pulls you in — don't stand in that line when he's stacked up.

playing.title: Only engage E with a minion behind him
playing.detail: E (Facebreaker) only stuns if enemies are on opposite sides of you; in a straight 1v1 it's just a slow. Route the wave so a minion sits on his far side before you commit.

playing.title: Bank Grit before you punch
playing.detail: W (Haymaker) passively stores damage taken as Grit and dumps it all on cast. Walk up and eat a Q or two first so the shield and true-damage punch actually matter.

playing.title: Respect a charged W
playing.detail: When his W (Path Maker) is up, he can charge to cut incoming damage then dash for a knockback/stun at 600 range. Stay outside that range until it's spent.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown window
playing.detail: After he dashes with E (Footwork) for the shield, it's down for 8-10 seconds depending on rank. Use Q's move speed to chase and force the fight in that window.

playing.title: Abuse his All Out defense drop
playing.detail: His R (All Out) hits harder and heals him, but it also lowers his defenses while active. If you can land E's stun and Q's bonus attacks during that window, the trade swings hard your way.

playing.title: Save R to break his all-in
playing.detail: The Show Stopper can interrupt his R (All Out) commitment or reposition him away from his own minions once he's overextended into you.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and every win-rate figure here are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — Grit banking, the E stun-vs-slow condition, and the All Out defense window — is my own read, not part of the measured data.
